p: mighty man: O Doeg, who half consider to be the tyrant Saul, and had the power to murder the saints of God.
mischiefs: Your malice moves you by crafty flattery and lies to accuse and destroy the innocents.
destroy thee for ever: Though God forbear for a time, yet at length he will recompense your falsehood.
root thee out of the land: Even though you seem to be never so sure settled.
righteous also shall see: For the eyes of the reprobate are shut at God's judgments.
and fear: With joyful reverence, seeing that he takes their part against the wicked.
green olive tree in the house: He rejoices to have a place among the servant's of God, that he may grow in the knowledge of godliness.
